description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Danitha enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
